Easy to use and very easy to clean.
I enjoy using it.
I would propose one improvement: to reduce the holes size of the charcoal baskets to reduce the amount of lumps that fall down, however I don't know if this will impact the charcoal temperature.
Overall I'm happy with that grill
Results.Title: Excellent charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: I ordered directly from Weber, grill was packed well and shipped quickly. Package arrived as predicted and in good condition. Unpacking and set up was simple using the easy to understand directions. I actually reviewed some of the Weber videos and read the directions on use, amount of charcoal etc. I have been using for about one month, 2-3 times a week and am very pleased. Steaks, ribs, burgers and chicken were cooked exactly as desired. Meat cooks evenly and I am impressed with the level of heat. Having the built-in thermometer is a plus. The ability to easily add more charcoal without removing the entire grate is a plus. I am very pleased with this model. I had a small 18” kettle over 10 years ago and switched to a Weber propane model that was convenient but did not cook consistently. We recently moved, leaving our old grill behind and decided to try a charcoal kettle and am very pleased pleased with the purchase. Highly recommend this model, somewhat pricey but very worth it for my needs.
Results.Title: Great charcoal grill for the price

Results.ReviewText: This my second Weber charcoal kettle grill and I have a Smokey Mountain Cooker as well as a Genesis II gas grill.  The previous 22 inch charcoal grill was used frequently (and year-round) and lasted us nineteen years!  The new one has a much better ash collection system and the two two retainer trays keep the coals conveniently in place when doing indirect cooking!

Results.ReviewText:
Have used a Weber genesis propane grill for years now...decided i have room on the deck for a charcoal grill too! 
Now i remember what real grilled food tastes like! The propane IS quicker and less messy, but the flavor from charcoal is another level. I will keep my Genesis, cooking that requires longer time, but the charcoal is my daily go-to.

I contacted Weber and let them know and they sent me a replacement within a couple weeks. Excellent customer service!

Very happy with the quality and the performance of this kettle grill
 Plenty of color choices the  deep ocean blue looks awesome
Results.Title: Nothing but the best

Results.ReviewText:
I have had Weber grills for the last 20 years.  Moved to a new location and converted four neighbors over to Smokey Joes.  It was the flavor from indirect heat grilling that won them over.
Getting them to also buy the rotisserie kit.
I have grilled Thanksgiving turkeys on my Weber.  You cut the rib bone out and separate the thighs from the bird prior to cooking.  Set up coals for indirect on both sides of the kettle.  Cross the legs and thighs and place the rest of the turkey over them.  An 18lbs turkey will be done in 90 minutes with the dark and white meat done at the same time.  Do a practice run with a large chicken first.
Results.Title: Spread the information

Results.ReviewText: I cannot believe I haven’t owned a a Weber before. It’s amazing how easy it is to cook on. I’ll definitely never own another grill.
Results.Title: Second to none

Results.ReviewText:
This is a great grill. Quality is very good. Only complaint is the legs snap in and it’s wobbly unlike the older models. Mine had a small dent in the lid edge that doesn’t affect anything, but just sucks cosmetically and for a little rust. Don’t know where or when it happened, but I assume since it was purchased assembled it happened then. 
Can’t wait till the pellet grill gets all the kinks worked out as that’s next!
Results.Title: Weber is my favorite grills

Results.ReviewText: ....I wish i got the 26 inch! Love all the fetchers!
Results.Title: I love it but....

Results.ReviewText: I have been very happy with this grill. I have done simple grilled burgers and brats to pizzas on a pizza stone and all have been Great! Because I have to move my grill every time I have to use it, I wish there was a wheel on the front leg. I think this would take some of the strain off the front leg that causes it to get a little wobbly.
Results.Title: Awesome Grill

Results.ReviewText: I've only used the kettle twice, once for ribs and once for a whole chicken and I am very happy with the results. Although I still need to learn better temperature control.
Results.Title: I'm getting the hang of it

14501001.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14501001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate fits circular GBS grillware· Included Char-Rails make it easy to arrange charcoal· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Tuck-Away Lid Holder provides handy space to hang lid· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels.· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant and 2” taller· 10-year limited warranty
